response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), t AS (SELECT g.ordersmark, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions) AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT t.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM t) SELECT ordersmark AS order_reference, cnt AS execution_count, share, share - avg_share AS diff_from_avg FROM a ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
